fusions.name: Crumb Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks a spore that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 50% of the damage the poison deals.

fusions.name: Plague Gust
fusions.desc: Exhales a cone of rot 5 tiles long that deals 9 damage to everything caught in it, costs 5% of your maximum health and leaves each hit target [Diseased] for 6 seconds with a 35% chance.

fusions.name: Cellar Colony
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 14 seconds that stings an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Survivor's Flush
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 25%, you regain 5 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.
